provenance_note: The plain routing snapshot is a deterministic reduced representation of the audited 138-row Pará extract. Latitude and longitude were parsed from georef_location; fields not required for service identification or routing were omitted. The SHA-256 of the original 13-column filtered Pará snapshot is retained as para_snapshot_sha256.
primary_supply_rule: One validated physical CREAS unit equals one supply opportunity within the CREAS category.
capacity_rule: Capacity is not required for the primary accessibility analysis.
